profile_text.body:
Twilio Inc is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading under the ticker TWLO and filing with the SEC under CIK 0001447669. Its website describes a platform for building customer experiences with APIs for SMS, RCS, voice, and email, along with conversational AI and identity verification. The company says the platform connects communication channels, customer context, and AI on one flexible platform, with flexible plans and pay-as-you-go pricing.

The company describes its platform as built for the "agentic era," where humans and AI agents work together across channels. According to the site, AI agents draw from internal knowledge and real-time data, transfer conversations to humans with full context when needed, and aim to make interactions continuous and personal. The site also mentions identity verification for trust.

Twilio is associated with 281 California legal exposure matters. No specific lawsuits are identified in the legal records.
